title: Noise-Injection Sandbagging Detector on Small Open Models

original_idea.body: # Noise-Injection Sandbagging Detector on Small Open Models. Sweep weight-noise levels on a prompted-sandbagger vs matched-weaker small model; success = a statistically significant non-monotonic hump for the sandbagger across two domains.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Separating sandbaggers from genuinely weak models enables external open-weight auditing.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Prompted sandbagging + weight-noise sweep on small models; guided, single GPU.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Tightly scoped noise-vs-accuracy curve with explicit non-monotonic-hump success criterion.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Infrastructure-light auditing of open weights, no internal access; labs deprioritize.

low_compute.reasoning: ~10 noise levels x full benchmark inference on an 8B model, single GPU but several GPU-hours.

novelty.reasoning: Noise-injection sandbagging detection already published; this is a small-model replication.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Detection method published; this replicates on small open models.
